message.content: {"caption":"Four-panel evaluation figure comparing Memento with baselines and memory configurations across benchmarks and out-of-distribution tasks.","description":"The target is a composite of four charts. (b) A grouped bar chart compares Memento, Memento without CBR, and online and offline executors on DeepResearcher, SimpleQA, and HLE. (c) A line chart plots accuracy over iterations for Memento without CBR and with non-parametric or parametric CBR.
